# Step - cap

`cap` · category: [Aggregation](../../traversal/step_reference.md#aggregation)

Emits the value of the named side effect(s) (one map for several keys) after the stream is exhausted.

## Forms

```text
cap()
cap(arg1: any)
cap(arg1: array)
cap(arg1: any, arg2: any)
cap(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v().group_count("c").by(T.label).cap("c").next()   // #{"person": 4, "software": 2}
```
